gallery.artist: InSapphoWeTrust from Los Angeles, California, USA
gallery.description:
San Francisco's Chinese population dates back all the way to the 1840s Gold Rush. The Chinese have been an integral part of San Francisco's social fabric ever since, despite severe backlash from the rest of the society that persisted well into the 1960s.

Very memorable architecture on this hospital building.
